title: Salvage Run
subtitle: Alliance-locked team suggestions that move your plan forward while you clear your daily Salvage Run battles.

track.label: Alliance track
track.shortfall: You own {{owned}} {{track}} characters. A full team needs three, so {{needed}} more are required. Only {{track}} characters can be used on this track.

purpose.title: Salvage Run team recommendations
purpose.content: Suggested Salvage Run teams for one alliance track at a time, built from your selected project, active goals, and roster, so your daily battles also advance your plan.

track.title: Alliance track
track.content: Pick the Imperial, Chaos, or Xenos track. Every recommendation below is limited to that alliance — no character from another alliance is ever suggested. Your choice is remembered.

mode.title: XP or Power
mode.content: XP Mode prefers characters that can still earn XP. Power Mode ignores XP and picks your strongest team. Your choice is remembered per page.

project.title: Driving project
project.content: Pick which project the Plan team is tuned to. This is the same project selection used on the other Dailies tabs.

teamSize.title: Team size
teamSize.content: Choose 3, 4, or 5 characters for both teams. A full team of 5 is the default; drop to 3 or 4 to concentrate each battle's shared XP on fewer characters. Your choice is remembered.

preferences.title: Preferred trait and damage type
preferences.content: Bias both teams toward a trait or damage type you want to field. It is a soft nudge — the team widens within the track's alliance to stay full rather than shrink, and a preference nobody on the track matches is ignored.

plan.title: Plan team
plan.content: One team tuned to your selected project, widening to your other goals and the track's full roster when it needs more characters. A note shows when it was widened.

locks.title: Lock what you like
locks.content: Lock a character in the Random team and it stays put when you regenerate. Locks reset when you reload or switch track.

regenerate.title: Regenerate
regenerate.content: Shuffle a new Random team. Only the unlocked slots change; it is disabled once every slot is locked.
